Thought for 7s

You now have a Goals screen, opened from a new link in the header. You can create a goal with a name, target amount and deadline, add money to it, and see a progress bar plus how much you still need to save each month. Goals are still there after a reload.

The monthly amount counts the current month and the deadline's month. If the deadline has passed, the goal says so and shows how much is left. You can also delete a goal.

What I tested and how

Automated tests: 34 of 34 pass, including 7 new ones for goals:
With 900.00 left over 6 months, it asks for 150.00 a month.
Uneven splits round up to the next cent, so 100.00 over 3 months is 33.34 a month.
A deadline this month asks for the full amount left.
Going over the target stops the bar at 100% and shows "reached".
A deadline that has passed shows as missed.
The form rejects a missing name, a zero target and a past deadline.
Goals are saved and loaded back correctly.
In a real browser at 1280px and 375px wide:
Opened Goals from the main page.
Submitting an empty form showed all three error messages.
Created "Holiday" (1,200 by 30 April 2027): it showed 200.00 a month for 6 months.
Added 300: the bar moved to 25% and the monthly amount dropped to 150.00.
Reloaded the page and the goal and its progress were unchanged.
Nothing scrolled sideways and the page showed no errors at either width. I also checked the phone-size screenshot by eye.
